K1 round 2 C3b/C4 stored replay day-order repair: load day-d state and stored caches before RPM with K(d-1), then K(d), forced snapshot and planning-only restoration; suppress post-override RPM recomputation and exclude non-TC states from the observed-grid maximum. Independent simcalc checks validate every forced RPM, every stored cache and all immediate state fields. The four cache_applications counters double (402->804, 5->10, 4->8, 27->54) because the pre-RPM and post-snapshot planning phases each apply them. Forced DpsData now equals stored day d (mismatch-days 401->0); fresh-planning equality count 14464->13752 is diagnostic rather than a floor test. On the preserved after-first-override day range, observed-grid carried cells change 730->1522 and skip 0->74; nonzero cell count stays 1604. Checkpoint/recomputed/free controls remain unchanged. Only these eight measured keys move; retain every ORIGINAL entry. See Runbook 19.2 and 24.7.
